## Delivered (core card, all three migration commits)

1. **Resolver + gate + `others`** — `resolveToolAvailability` gains `essentialNames`/`conditionalNames` and emits `discoverableNames` alongside `discoverableIds`: the default partition demotes per NAME (keep-12 `read/write/edit/ls/bash/bash_job/lsp/web_search/web_fetch/memory_add/memory_search/reply`; the `memory` family splits; `reply` stays inside the deferred `task` family; family-less ids `dap`/`sqlite` and every `mcp:<server>` family demote at id level). `off` beats demotion (I3); `tools: {id: on}` standing mounts survive (I5). `others_tool.dart` replaces `discover_tools_tool.dart` (deleted, no alias): registered iff discovery on AND ≥1 deferred tool exists; lists one-line docs grouped by family; mounts ONE tool per call returning the tool's own `description` + compact `jsonEncode(parameters)` — the ledger bytes (I4); unknown/disabled/already-mounted each answer pinned text and never throw; `others` has no `args` and never executes (I2). omp discovers through `others`; `pi` keeps its exact 4-tool shape with discovery off (`hello_token_parity` still ≤ 12,345 — green).
2. **Capability predicates + live sync** — `generate_image`/`generate_video` register iff the slot is set and not unsupported (`mediaGenerationSlotCapability`, pure config check — no key reads for a manifest decision); `decide` iff the main provider is OpenRouter (the call-time gate is the registration predicate); `inspect_image` unchanged. Live sync on `/models set|remove`, `/model`, `/provider` (all five switch funnels rebuild availability), and through `wireAgentCore` birth registration on every host.
3. **Surfaces + pin** — `/tools` renders loaded · deferred · off(reason) + the `others` row; tools-section prompt paragraph (`prompts/tools/tool_calling.md`, regenerated, `prompts_sync` green); docs/tool-availability.md §Load modes rewritten; sdk-subsystems tool line; CHANGELOG entry. **REG-1 hard gate**: `test/parity/manifest_size_parity_test.dart` pins the default boot manifest ≤ 21,000 wire chars computed from the real tool objects — measures **15,400** in the fake-env boot (keep-12 ∩ capabilities + `others` with all 18 CLI deferred names in the stub; on a fully-wired host the lsp/web schemas land it ≈ 18.6k, still under the pin).

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. This file is
the agent ENTRY document: the harness merges it into the system prompt with
a ~19 KB entry budget, so it must stay small enough to be fully visible.
Ceiling: **≤ 300 lines / ≤ 20 KB** — enforced by
`scripts/check_agents_md_size.sh` (pre-commit hook via `ci_fast_gate.sh` +
the CI `static` job). Subsystem essays live in `docs/` — index:
`docs/README.md`. Keep entries factual: paths, commands, invariants.

## Module map

```mermaid
flowchart TB
    subgraph CORE["SDK - flutter_agent_harness, pure Dart (lib/)"]
        AI["ai: providers, agent loop, sessions, compaction"]
        TOLS["tools: approval, redact, hashline, memory"]
        HOSTS["hosts: shared wiring, messaging, a2a, hub"]
    end
    subgraph PKG["packages/ - sibling Dart packages"]
        FAUI["fa_ui: widgets incl. trajectory"]
        DAP["dap_hub, fa_llm, fa_llm_mock"]
    end
    CLI["fa CLI - bin/ + lib/src/cli: TUI, slash commands, headless"]
    APP["Flutter app - flutter_app/: desktop, mobile, web shells"]
    EXT["Browser extension - browser_ext/ + lib/src/browser + serve_bridge"]
    OFFICE["Office add-in - office_addin/ + FA_HOST=office host"]
    GOLDEN["UI golden & styles - golden tests, themes, ui tests"]
    NETW["fa_network - external Go backend + network clients"]
    CORE --> CLI
    CORE --> APP
    CORE --> EXT
    PKG --> APP
    PKG --> CLI
    APP --> OFFICE

    APP --> NETW
    EXT --> NETW
    GOLDEN --> APP
    GOLDEN --> FAUI
```

## Project layout — one line per subsystem

Full subsystem reference: `docs/agents/sdk-subsystems.md` (SDK) +
`docs/agents/flutter-app-subsystems.md` (app/packages/repo-level).

**SDK core (`lib/`, pure Dart):**

- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers, session modes, per-tool overrides, critical-bash interceptor, per-turn grants.
- `lib/src/tools/` — `ask`/`request_secret`/media tools, `read` selectors + archives + sqlite, background shell jobs, availability + load modes.
- `lib/src/env/` — `ExecutionEnv` impls: `LocalShell` (setsid, killTree, drain caps, self-signal immunity), session-correlation vars, in-memory default.
- `lib/src/agent/` — FinalizeGate, tool pairing, session image registry.
- `lib/src/trajectory/` — trajectory ledger core; goldens under `test/trajectory/goldens/`.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (prompt, tool args, output, logs).
- `lib/src/hashline/` — `[path#TAG]` patch language (SWAP/DEL/INS, stale-tag rejection).
- `lib/src/compaction/` — branch summarization + AutoCompactor → policy: `docs/compaction.md`.
- `lib/src/lsp/`, `lib/src/mcp/` — `lsp` + MCP protocol tooling (lazy servers, pure-Dart transports).
- `lib/src/model_roles/` — roles/fallbacks/keyring/watchdogs + provider catalog; `lib/src/ttsr/` — streaming-interrupt rules.
- `lib/src/skills/`, `lib/src/prompts/` — skills discovery; AGENTS/CLAUDE/GOAL/DESIGN auto-merge into the system prompt.
- `lib/src/task/`, `lib/src/messaging/`, `lib/src/session/attach/` — subagents, inbox fabric, attached sessions → `docs/subagents/README.md`.
- `lib/src/memory/` — long-term memory (hosted `flutter_agent_memory` package) → pitfalls: `docs/memory-churn.md`.
- `lib/src/a2a/` — Agent2Agent client/server/manager (`fa serve --a2a`).
- `bin/fah.dart` + `lib/src/cli/` — the `fa` CLI: REPL, slash commands, headless/serve modes → `docs/agents/cli.md`.
- `lib/src/cube/` — fa_cube sandbox profiles → `docs/cubes.md`; `lib/src/cli/hep.dart` — HEP event protocol → `docs/hep.md`.
- `lib/src/web_search/` — `web_search` (DDG keyless → keyed providers); `tool/fa-clip/` — native macOS pasteboard helper.

**packages/ + app shells:**

- `packages/fa_ui/` — reusable widgets (incl. trajectory) → `docs/agents/fa-ui.md`; `dap_hub`, `fa_llm`, `fa_llm_mock` → `docs/dap.md`.
- `flutter_app/` — the Flutter app (desktop/mobile/web) → `docs/agents/flutter-app.md`; services one-liner: `docs/agents/services.md`; JS apps: `docs/agents/js-apps.md`; HomeKit/Calendar/CodeMie: `docs/agents/system-integrations.md`.
- `browser_ext/` + `lib/src/browser/` + `bin/serve_bridge.dart` — browser extension + WebSocket bridge → `docs/browser-extension.md`.
- `office_addin/` + FA_HOST=office app host — Office add-in → `docs/outlook-addin.md`.
- `fa_network` — external Go backend bridged via the DAP hub (channel-id caveats: `docs/dap.md` §14).
- `site/`, `scripts/`, `docs/subagents/` — landing page (privacy sync), gates + codegen, subagents master plan → `docs/agents/flutter-app-subsystems.md`.

## Hard architecture rules (stay inline)

- `lib/` is pure Dart: **no `dart:io`** (must compile for web). The only
  `dart:io` entry points are `bin/` and `lib/io.dart`; file/process/network
  behind tools goes through the `ExecutionEnv` abstraction.
- Barrel `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart`: grouped **APPEND-ONLY** export
  sections — one `// ── <subsystem> ──` header per group, sorted by path
  within a group, new exports append to their group. No mini-barrels, no
  re-sorting (gh-1232).
- God-file ceiling: no `.dart` file over **2800** lines (crap4dart `loc`
  gate). Target < 2000 for primary files; split by concern into `part`
  files — never by extracting public API.

## Working in parallel (shared checkout + worktrees)

Do not modify files in this shared checkout unless the user asked; run no
heavy commands (full suites/analyze) in it; never `git stash` the user's
WIP; talk to peer agents through the messaging fabric, not their files.
Worktrees only if genuinely required — ask first, create detached under
`.worktrees/<name>/` from the remote tracking ref, remove when done.
Full policy: `docs/agents/parallel-worktrees.md`.

## Memory (footnote)

Before any non-trivial task, **search memory first** (`memory_search`,
then `memory_list` for fuzzy topics). Scopes: **project** = this repo
(`.fah/memory/note/` since gh-2185 — local-only, not committed; the
user's files: read freely, write only via `memory_add`), **user** = global/private. `memory_add` stores durable facts
only; supersede by delete + add — never leave solved problems to rot. The
host recomposes the `<memory>` prompt section after every add; tool wiring
is `memoryTools` + `lib/src/memory/`. Churn pitfalls: `docs/memory-churn.md`;
usage details: `docs/agents/memory-usage.md`.

## Golden tests are MANDATORY for UI work

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done: coverage first (`test/goldens/` + `golden_guard_test.dart`
map), real fonts (`ensureGoldenFonts`), full frames (1280x800 / 390x844),
determinism, eyes on pixels after `--update-goldens`, green
`flutter test test/goldens` + `scripts/check_goldens.py` (orphan snapshots
hard-fail). Full rules: `docs/agents/golden-tests.md`.

## Prompts live outside Dart code

Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (YAML frontmatter,
`{{token}}` placeholders) — never string literals in `.dart`. After
editing: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` regenerates the `.g.dart`
files (`test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart` gates drift); Codex catalog
refresh: `dart run scripts/sync_codex_models.dart`. Details:
`docs/agents/prompts.md`.

## Quality gates (pre-commit hook: `scripts/pre-commit`)

The hook is a thin wrapper over `scripts/ci_fast_gate.sh`; CI classifies
PRs through the same script (`--dry-run`) — one classifier, one threshold
set, hook/CI parity via `GATE_STAGE` markers. Path rules: docs/markdown/
prompts-only → size + analyze; lib/bin/test/pubspec → +tests, coverage,
CRAP, dup, dupx; `test/integration/**` → +integration-mock;
flutter_app/packages → +flutter; scripts/.github → everything. Invariants:

- analyze + format clean; `dart test` green — **deterministic-only**
  (mock LLM; live models never in the gate; `llm`-tagged files run only in
  the tag-only provider smoke + nightly).
- Line coverage of `lib/` ≥ 80%; jscpd < 1% core / < 3.7% app; cross-module
  dup < 0.31%; CRAP ratchet: core 12.0, app 30.0 (thresholds only-down);
  ≤ 2800 lines per `.dart` file; AGENTS.md ceiling (top of this file).
- Red-in-≥2-distinct-SHA-runs flakes quarantine via
  `scripts/test_quarantine.json`; nightly keeps running quarantined files.

Full gate text: `docs/agents/quality-gates.md`; CI workflows: `docs/ci.md`.

## Cross-platform parity

Every shared setting and interactive prompt type exists on BOTH the CLI
and the Flutter app unless fundamentally impossible — then it MUST be in
`cliOnlySettings`/`appOnlySettings` (`lib/src/parity/settings_registry.dart`)
with the reason; run `dart test test/parity/`. Host capabilities (issue
#1079): every host-wiring capability declares its 7-host matrix state AT
BIRTH (`on` / `off(reason)` / `transport`) via `wireAgentCore` — `off` is
invisible everywhere; extensions are declared surface, SDK invariants have
no override point. Full rules: `docs/agents/cross-platform-parity.md`.

## Commits and releases

- Commit as `ai.teammate <agent.ai.native@gmail.com>` (set repo-locally);
  subjects `type(scope): ...`. Release-path automation MUST use the
  fa-release-bot GitHub App token — never a PAT or `GITHUB_TOKEN`.
- Every push to main cuts an annotated tag (`scripts/auto_release.sh`);
  the tag is the single version source (pubspecs stay `0.0.0-dev`);
  releases go DRAFT-first and publish at `release-provenance` only with
  signed SHA256SUMS attached. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only (`## Unreleased`).
- `packages/fa_llm` publishes per `fa_llm-v*` tag (first publish of a new
  package is manual); every lockfile is committed and enforced
  (`scripts/check_lockfiles.sh`); TestFlight external-group + store
  pipelines have required repo variables.

Full text: `docs/agents/commits-releases.md`.

## Bench

Bench knobs (agent timeouts, stall/watch, `FA_CONN_DEBUG`, hang replay,
report semantics) → `docs/bench.md` (round-3 knobs: issue #1392).

## Docs index

`docs/README.md` indexes every canonical doc (agents/, memory-churn,
compaction, dap, cubes, redaction, hep, ci, bench, browser-extension,
outlook-addin, …). New docs must be listed there.

---
name: self-settings
description: >
  Configure fa (flutter_agent_harness) itself by editing the exact config
  files the CLI settings commands write: provider/model selection and roles,
  memory paths, tool availability, cubes, MCP servers, redaction, skills

  path", "disable web_search for this project", "switch the theme to
  ohmypi").
when_to_use: Reconfiguring fa itself — settings, provider, models, memory,
  tools, cubes, MCP, redaction, skills access, themes/TUI appearance — on
  any host (CLI headless, REPL, app), by editing the YAML config the CLI
  persists (themes also via ~/.fah/themes/*.json), never by guessing keys.
argument-hint: "[what to configure, e.g. 'point project memory at ./memory']"
allowed-tools:
  - read
  - write
  - edit
  - ls
  - bash
  - config
user-invocable: true
disable-model-invocation: false
---

# fa self-configuration

You are reconfiguring fa itself. The config file IS the source of truth: the
CLI settings commands (`/provider`, `/tools`, `/approval`, …) are thin
editors over the same YAML this skill edits. Edit the file, never invent
keys, verify after every edit, and report what changed and when it applies.

## Hard rules

1. **Never invent keys.** Unknown top-level keys are ignored silently; strict
   sections throw `ConfigException` on unknown keys or bad value types and can
   break startup — `mcp:`, `memory:`, `cube:`, `providerTimeouts:`, `skills:`,
   `images:`, `models.custom` fields, `ttsr:`. The `tools:` section throws on
   non-boolean values; unknown TOOL ids only warn (and absent capabilities can
   never be force-enabled). Every key you write must come from this document.
2. **Never write API key VALUES into config.yaml.** Config carries key NAMES
   (`apiKeyName:`) only. Values live in the OS secure store (`/key set`) or the
   environment. A key value in YAML is a leaked secret.
3. **Preserve the file.** Edit surgically (the `edit` tool, or `write` only for
   a file you fully own). Keep comments and unrelated keys byte-identical.
4. **Verify after every edit.** Run the `config` tool's `check` op (or
   `fa config check`) and confirm it passes before declaring success. A
   broken file must be detected by you, not discovered at next boot.
5. **Report scope + application.** Every change report states: which file, which
   scope, and whether it applies live or at next boot.

## Config layout and precedence

| File | Scope | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `~/.fah/config.yaml` | user (global) | main settings file; loaded by `loadCliConfig` |
| `<project>/.fah/config.yaml` | project | only the `memory:`, `cube:`, `tools:`, `spills:` sections are read from here — each wins over the user file |

# GOAL — flutter_agent_harness

## Objective

Build the **ideal cross-platform AI agent harness in Dart**, ported from the
architecture of **pi-mono** (`packages/ai` + `packages/agent`), publishable on
pub.dev and runnable everywhere Dart runs: **VM, Flutter desktop, iOS/Android,
and web**. The core package must stay **pure Dart** — no `dart:io`, no Flutter
imports in `lib/` (platform specifics live behind abstractions).

This repo is the successor to the adk_dart-based assistant stack in the
`yoclip` project; once mature it will power the yoclip Studio AI assistant.

## Reference codebases (read these first)

### Primary architecture reference — pi-mono

`/Users/Uladzimir_Klyshevich/git/references/pi/`

- `packages/ai/` (~8.7k LOC TS) — provider adapters behind one contract:

    canonical adapter; also covers OpenRouter (`baseUrl` swap, first-class).

  - `packages/ai/src/stream.ts` — event contract:

    delta event carries the **live partial message** (partial-first design).
  - `packages/ai/src/utils/overflow.ts` — provider-specific context-overflow
    detection via error-message regexes.
  - **Invariant to preserve: providers never throw.** All failures —

🚨 **BLOCKING: the default partition defers `config` — the self-config subsystem is broken and the PTY/CLI integration CI shard is red (3 tests)**

`config` is absent from the keep-12 (`essentialToolNamesByLoadMode`, this
line) and from `conditionalCapabilityToolNames`, so the default partition
demotes it into `discoverableNames` (`lib/src/tools/availability.dart`) and
`ToolAvailabilityGate.wrapExecutor` (`lib/src/tools/availability_gate.dart:290`)
tombstones every direct `config` call with "deferred (not loaded) — call
`others` …" before it reaches the executor.

That breaks the self-config contract (issue #29 S4):

- the `self-settings` skill (`prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`)
  declares `config` in `allowed-tools` and mandates a `config` `check` op
  after every edit;
- its scripted acceptance suite `test/integration/self_config_e2e_test.dart`
  (unchanged by this PR) drives `config` as the FIRST call of every
  scenario — now tombstoned, nothing lands.

CI on this head (run 45630982662, commit `f2ded7ec`, PTY/CLI integration
linux shard 0/3 — 67 passed, **3 failed**):

- AC4 `test/integration/self_config_e2e_test.dart:122` — the project config
  file is never created (`Expected: true / Actual: <false>`);
- AC5 `test/integration/self_config_e2e_test.dart:193` —
  `tools.web_search: false` is never written (`Actual: ''` — the file is
  empty);
- AC6 `test/integration/self_config_e2e_test.dart:285` — `customProviders`
  is empty (`Expected: an object with length of <1> / Actual: []`).

Both AC4 and AC5 were reproduced locally on this head with the identical
signatures. The mechanism is confirmed green-side too: the rewritten
`test/cli/load_mode_cli_test.dart` pins the boot contract where `config` is
deferred, and the parity test pins `config` in the stub's 18 deferred names —
so the demotion is deliberate per the GOAL #28 card, but its collision with
the self-config subsystem was missed.

A real model can recover via `others` (one extra round trip per session),
but every scripted/automation consumer of the CLI harness and the skill's
documented flow break — and the suite is red, which blocks merge on its own
(AGENTS.md: `dart test` green is a gate invariant).

Fix options:

1. **Add `config` to the keep-12** (my read: the intended fix — self-config
   is exactly the feature issue #29 S4 pins, and the stub is small enough
   that the AC9 ≤ 21,000-char pin still holds);
2. or rewrite the skill + e2e suite to the two-step `others → config` flow
   and accept the extra round trip for every self-config session.

Either way this needs an explicit decision in this PR, and the integration
shard must go green before merge.

💡 **SUGGESTION: the `others` stub's schema description is frozen at registration**

`syncOthersTool` registers the stub once and then early-returns for the rest
of the session while it exists (this line). The description baked in by
`_othersDescription(...)` — "Deferred tools (not loaded): config,
memory_list, …" — therefore never updates:

- after a mount, the mounted name is still advertised as "not loaded" in the
  schema the provider serializes on every request;
- an MCP server connecting later grows `discoverableToolNames` (the doc
  comment itself says "an MCP server connecting later re-loads it through
  the next rebuild"), but its names never enter the description — only the
  live listing (`tool_name` omitted) reflects them.

Nothing breaks — the mount path answers "already loaded" + docs (E10) — but
the manifest text actively misleads the model about what is loaded. Either
re-register the stub with a fresh description on each rebuild (the AC9
wire-size pin still holds: the description shrinks as tools mount), or drop
the frozen name list from the description and let the live listing carry it.
The same early-return pattern is in
`flutter_app/lib/services/agent_tool_availability.dart` (`_syncOthersTool`).

🪶 **NIT: stale "discoverable" wording in the discovery-off tombstone**

GOAL #2416 renamed the vocabulary (discoverable → deferred) in the docs,
CHANGELOG, the `/tools` render, and in the discovery-on branch directly
above ("is **deferred** (not loaded) — call `others` …") — but this
discovery-off branch (lines 302–305) still tells the model the tool "is
**discoverable** and not loaded". Pure wording, nothing behavioral; align it
with the deferred vocabulary for consistency.
